summary: The edit_file tool uses safe string operations (split/join with literal strings, not regex) avoiding ReDoS and injection risks. No prototype pollution, SSRF, or credential leakage vectors present. Path traversal is delegated to the VFS abstraction layer which is the appropriate boundary. Error handling propagates exceptions cleanly without leaking sensitive data beyond the user-supplied path. The replacement count logic is correct for both exact-match and trimmed-match paths. No critical bugs or resource state issues identified.
